access.notes: Installable via pip or conda; provides MP2, HF, QCISD(T) and basis sets.
Standard basis sets; included with most quantum chemistry packages (e.g., Psi4) or obtainable from Basis Set Exchange (bse.pnl.gov).
Standard values from J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 1982 and later revisions; used in the atomization method. Widely available in thermochemical tables (e.g., NIST Webbook).
